transcription: Transcribed cell by cell from the rendered PDF table. Spot-check against the PDF before seeding.

choiceGroups.breakfast-fruit-or-egg: Pick one: fruit/banana OR boiled egg (not both).
choiceGroups.lunch-biryani: Pick one: paneer biryani OR chicken biryani.
choiceGroups.lunch-sunday-curry: Pick one: palak paneer OR chicken curry.
choiceGroups.breakfast-dosa: Wheat dosa OR pesarattu (whichever the mess serves that day).

notes: Items with limited=true are marked *** in the PDF (limited quantity).
servingQuantity, when present, overrides the food's default serving for that menu slot (e.g. Vada (3)).
